messages.text: <https://view.rippling.com/viewer/3e3e8498971cf0a4ffb7e74f2698be0f>

The 3 modules we're considering:

• IAM (Identity & Access Management)
Automated provisioning/deprovisioning tied to Bamboo, SSO across apps, and password management to eliminate the manual offboarding + access gaps you’re seeing today.
• MDM (Device Management)
Full control beyond Apple Business Manager including patching, software deployment, remote access, and improved reliability vs. failed installs and manual troubleshooting.
• IVM (Inventory Management)
Centralized tracking of devices and ancillary equipment with visibility into lifecycle (aging devices, refresh planning) and optional logistics like shipping/retrieval and buyback.
